Glad it's working. I saved the wkhtmltopdf fix to EngramDB as a hazard: newer versions need `--enable-local-file-access`, or the invoice PDF tests fail. That way it's findable if the tests break again after an upgrade or in a fresh environment.

I didn't change any code in the repo, since you'd already fixed it locally.
